---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new capability
labels: enhancement
---

**Is your feature request related to a problem?**
A description of the problem, e.g. "I cannot evaluate on meeting-style audio...".

**Describe the solution you'd like**
What you want to happen.

**Alternatives considered**
Any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

**Ethics check**
If this feature affects scoring behaviour, how does it impact false-positive
rate (flagging honest candidates)? See [docs/ethics.md](../../docs/ethics.md).

**Additional context**
Add any other context, links to papers, or screenshots.
